# MIRU

> MIRU (https://miru.plus) is an interactive romance-story and AI character chat app. Readers play as themselves, talk with the characters and make choices in every chapter that change relationships, the plot and the ending. Stories are written by the MIRU team; characters' live replies are generated by AI within each story's written personalities and safety rules. All characters are fictional adults. Free to start, in the browser on phone or computer; available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

## Key pages

- [Home / play](https://miru.plus/): the app itself
- [All stories](https://miru.plus/stories/): catalog with premise, characters and chapters for every story
- [About](https://miru.plus/about.html)
- [Contact](https://miru.plus/contact.html)
- [Privacy](https://miru.plus/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://miru.plus/terms.html)

## Stories

- [I Kissed My Professor](https://miru.plus/stories/i-kissed-my-professor.html): The stranger you kissed last night is your professor this morning.
  - Premise: On a masquerade terrace, a stranger in a silver mask asked first—then kissed you. The next morning, the new professor walks into your Halden seminar. It's him. Adrian Blackwood doesn't pretend not to know you; he files a recusal that same day, giving up any say over your grades or your work. Meanwhile, fellow painter Ethan slides a midnight studio ticket across your desk, and collector Nathan wants to fund your first solo show—while insisting the contract and his dinner invitation stay two separate things. Three men, three kinds of heat. Fall for one, be honest with all of them, or choose no one at all. Your work only ever carries your name.
  - Characters: Adrian (Art scholar and the new seminar professor—the masked stranger who kissed you); Ethan (A fellow graduate painter who says exactly what he feels); Nathan (A private art collector who wants to fund your show); Avery (Independent registrar handling the recusal); Mara (Independent gallery curator); Elise (Your independent replacement advisor)
  - Tags: 男女, 师生禁忌, 三角恋, 艺术学院, 化装舞会

- [The Plus-One Pact](https://miru.plus/stories/the-plus-one-pact.html): He said he’d wanted you for fourteen months. Now he might leave in thirty days.
  - Premise: At your best friend's wedding rehearsal, your ex grabs the mic: 'Who would ever love you seriously?' Theo Bennett, the chef you've argued with for three days, raises his flour-covered hand. 'I would. I've liked her for fourteen months.' It wasn't a plan. Now the whole room thinks you're together, and the wedding is thirty days away. He can make you laugh over ruined dessert, blush on the dance floor, and admit when jealousy gets the better of him. But the morning after the wedding, Theo must answer a job offer in New York. If everyone else thinks you're pretending, how do you tell whether he means it?
  - Characters: Theo (Wedding Banquet Chef); Naomi (The Bride and Her Friend); Colin (Your Ex)
- [Letters From Tomorrow](https://miru.plus/stories/letters-from-tomorrow.html): You got a breakup letter from seven days in the future. Then the man it named walked in.
  - Premise: At midnight, a letter arrives from you, seven days in the future. It says you'll kiss a man at the train station, then beg him never to come back. You've never met the man. Ten minutes later, a rain-soaked repairman named Evan walks into your flower shop with a crushed white blossom and a shy smile. He remembers the little things you say, gets awkward on dates, and sometimes says the wrong thing when he's jealous. Every night, another future letter arrives, and the predictions keep changing. You know the date of the goodbye. You don't know whether it must happen. Would you risk falling in love anyway?
  - Characters: Evan (Historic Building Restorer); Nia (Flower Shop Partner); Mrs. Bell (Retired Post Office Employee)
- [The Dragon's Last Trial](https://miru.plus/stories/the-dragon-s-last-trial.html): The dragon begs for a death sentence. A second man tears up his own protection to stop the trial.
  - Premise: The city is freezing. To relight its last great lamp, the court wants to take the heart-fire of the dragon warrior chained before you. But the execution needs your signature. Dorian asks for three days and looks at you as though you're the first person who has truly seen him. The city's perfect magistrate, Silas, tears up his own immunity order to show you a law someone hid. One man is fire; the other has spent his life hiding sparks beneath ice. Neither is as certain as he looks. You can question them, refuse them, fall for one of them, or save their lives without promising your heart. Can you find another way to keep the city warm?
  - Characters: Dorian (Dragon Commander); Silas (Royal Inspector); Mara (Regent of the Royal City); Rowan (Old Lamp Founder)

A vampire who remembers everything, an emergency doctor with recurring dreams, and a hunter bound by a blood oath hold conflicting accounts. Yet the original pact never required your death. Verify the altered terms, rescue people the city is forgetting, and decide who may share a future without a countdown. Love, friendship, and independence begin with what you want now.
  - Characters: Lucien (Lucien Voss, vampire prince); Rowan (Rowan Ashford, emergency physician); Cassian (Cassian Thorne, hunter); Mara (Mara Ellery, independent archive custodian; non-romantic); Evelyn (Evelyn Rook, council chair; non-romantic)

  - Premise: The ring box is still open on the table, and your fiancé slides a glass of water toward you. Your phone says the engagement party is in three days. Last time, he stopped you in the second-floor parlor and pushed you off the terrace—and as everything went dark, the system whispered, "Mission accomplished." Only you remember your past life, and now the system is urging you to say yes to a date.

## FAQ

- Is MIRU free? Yes, every story can be started for free; optional extra scenes use diamonds that can also be earned by playing.
- Do I need to download an app? No. MIRU runs in any modern browser at https://miru.plus on phones and computers.
- Is the content explicit? No sexually explicit content; all characters are fictional adults (17+ audience).
